column7: UpdateOwnProfile decided "email unchanged, no re-auth" on its own read, then passed the email to UpdateUser, which compared it with a second read: an email change committing in between (the web page always resends the email) made the request an email change that skipped re-auth, from a session only. Fixed by dropping an email equal to the re-auth read. Postgres twin: TestCTAReview_UserRowNarrow_OwnProfileEmailChangedBetweenReads_CrossReplicaPostgres. Found by FIX-USER-ROW-NARROW-1 review
